# lab/tests/fixtures

Small Parquet inputs for the lab tests, regenerated by `lab/make_fixtures.py`
(see its docstring for the commands):

- `engine/`: the first 200 submissions and 2000 decisions of a seed-7 fake run
  (`decision/`, `submission/`).
- `chain/`: 100 preview transactions with the rows the statistics join to
  (`block/`, `certificate/`, `tx/`, `tx_input/`, `tx_output/`).

Each leaf directory is one table holding `part-000000.parquet`.
`make lab` mounts this directory as `/data` by default (`LAB_DATA`).
